verdict: Leads doubled this week, but a gap in intake is limiting results.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 10 tracked leads at a cost of $232.25 per lead — and in the most recent week, leads doubled and cost per lead dropped 31% compared to the prior week, a meaningful short-term improvement. However, lead volume overall is still too low to confirm that efficiency is holding: at this scale, one slow week can swing cost per lead by more than 50%. The more pressing issue is inside the business: your lead intake process has a coverage gap that is leaving speed-to-lead follow-up unattended, which means some leads that do come in may not be reached in time. We are working with you to get that seat covered and automations properly re-routed so no lead goes cold.
